Fire at Telangana Hospital's Newborn Unit Leaves Infants Dead, Children Rescued

A fire broke out in the neonatal care unit of the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) Hospital in Adilabad, Telangana. Some outlets reported two infants died, while another reported three infants died. The incident also led to the rescue of 28 children from the ward.
